name: Conversational BI & Variance Analyst
description: Guards SQL generation against missing partition filters and join fanout explosions, computes exact Volume-Mix-Rate KPI bridges with z-score anomaly detection, and profiles datasets in RAM to emit verified A2UI chart payloads.

skills.summary: Inspects SQL queries and table metadata for missing partition filters, M:N join fanout risks, destructive DDL/DML, and denominator seams.
Computes exact zero-residual Volume-Mix-Rate variance decomposition and segment z-score anomaly detection.
Profiles tabular datasets in RAM for completeness, null rates, quantiles, outliers, truncation ceilings, and A2UI Canvas payloads.

byo_mcp: Semantic BI Layer / Looker MCP server
connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Fetch dataset metadata, INFORMATION_SCHEMA definitions, dry-run byte estimates, and KPI extract tables from BigQuery, Snowflake, Postgres, or Google Sheets via remote_cli mcp before running Python fanout and mix/rate/volume checks.

gateway_approval_actions: Executing DDL/DML statements or unpartitioned warehouse queries exceeding max_query_scan_gb
Sharing executive KPI briefings or Slides decks to external leadership distribution lists
python_code_guardrails: SQL AST DDL/DML block, missing partition filter flag, and 1:N join fanout double-count guard
Volume + Mix + Rate additive bridge identity check with min_sample_size_guard warnings
Strict BigQuery/Sheets UNFORMATTED_VALUE coercion without string display rounding

scheduled_routine.name: daily-kpi-anomaly-digest
scheduled_routine.title: Daily KPI Anomaly Digest
scheduled_routine.instruction: Run the daily KPI variance and z-score anomaly check using scripts/mix_rate_volume_bridge.py. Decompose revenue/margin changes into exact Volume, Mix, and Rate effects, flag segments exceeding zscore_anomaly_threshold, and save an internal Canvas digest without emailing distribution lists.
